descriptionFromApi:
About the Role
Bolster has partnered with a major technology provider (the Partner ) to offer a white-labeled version of our brand protection solution to the Partners customer base. Were hiring a Technical Account Manager (TAM) to act as the primary technical liaison between Bolster and the Partner, making sure customers who purchase our solution through this partnership get the support they actually need - especially when that need falls outside what the Partner provides at no additional cost.
The Partner supports its customers through several layers: a Service Account Manager who handles account, billing, and user-management matters; a baseline technical support team that provides break-fix support; paid integration packages that help with configuration and training; and a range of paid professional/managed services offering deeper technical support and named account resources. This TAM will need to understand that structure well enough to know exactly where the Partners support ends and where Bolster needs to step in - and then be the one who steps in.
This same TAM will also support named enterprise and strategic accounts sold directly by Bolster, acting as the primary product expert on calls alongside our enterprise Customer Success Managers to drive product adoption and expand how customers use the platform. In practice, this is a dual-motion role: one foot in the Partners support ecosystem, one foot embedded with Bolsters own enterprise book of business.
Work Authorization: Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States. We are not able to sponsor visas or provide employment-based immigration support for this position now or in the future.
What Youll Do
  • Serve as Bolsters primary point of contact for the Partners account and support teams - Service Account Managers, baseline technical support, and professional/managed services teams - on everything related to our white-labeled product.
  • Learn and navigate the Partners tiered support model well enough to identify, for any given customer issue, whether its covered by the Service Account Manager, baseline technical support, a paid integration package, or a professional/managed services offering - or whether it isnt covered by the Partner at all.
  • Work with the Partners professional/managed services teams to clarify which of our products and services fall within scope of each service package, and fill in context where their teams need it.
  • Act as the escalation point when a customer needs help beyond what the Partner provides for free: for example, deeper product configuration, ongoing tuning, or hands-on help that isnt included in a paid integration or in baseline technical support.
  • Support onboarding and managed integrations for the solution, including training customers both on initial setup and on ongoing maintenance - e.g., configuring automated takedowns and maintaining protected assets over time.
  • Track recurring support themes and pain points across accounts, and feed that back to our product, sales, and customer success teams so we can improve documentation, packaging, and pricing over time.
  • Build strong, collaborative relationships with the Partners account managers, support engineers, and services staff so that handoffs and escalations stay smooth on both sides.
Supporting Bolsters Enterprise Accounts
  • Serve as the dedicated technical resource for a portfolio of named enterprise and strategic accounts sold directly by Bolster, working in lockstep with each accounts Customer Success Manager.
  • Join CSM-led customer calls as the product expert - answering technical questions, unblocking issues in real time, and spotting opportunities to expand how the customer uses the platform.
  • Help enterprise customers configure and tune Bolsters monitoring and takedown workflows - across domains, social media, app stores, marketplaces, and the dark web - to fit their brands specific risk profile.
  • Stay current on the broader digital-risk and fraud-protection landscape so you can speak credibly to how Bolster fits alongside a customers other security and brand-protection investments.
  • Be the product expert on customer calls and continue to learn about adjacent technologies and services in the fraud space.
What Were Looking For
  • Experience in Technical Account Management, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success Engineering, or a similar customer-facing technical role.
  • Experience working within a channel partner, reseller, or white-label business model - ideally with a large enterprise technology partner.
  • Comfortable supporting a portfolio of enterprise or strategic accounts alongside a Customer Success team, in addition to partner-sourced customers - this role covers both motions.
  • Solid understanding of tiered SaaS support models (break-fix vs. professional services vs. managed services vs. account management).
  • Strong communicator, comfortable acting as the bridge between teams - and between companies - and translating between business and technical stakeholders.
  • Self-directed and comfortable with ambiguity, while staying organized and reliable.
  • Preferred: experience with brand protection, anti-phishing, domain takedown, digital risk protection, or similar cybersecurity/brand-safety products.
  • Preferred: familiarity with common digital-abuse vectors - phishing, typosquatting/domain spoofing, social media and app-store impersonation, fraudulent ads, and marketplace scams - and how takedowns actually get executed (registrars, hosting providers, platform trust safety teams, DMCA/UDRP-style processes).
  • Preferred: comfort working with API-driven, integration-heavy products - Bolsters detection and takedown workflows rely heavily on automation and direct platform integrations.
  • Preferred: experience working with or alongside a Security Operations Center (SOC), fraud, or brand-security team on the customer side.
  • Preferred: familiarity with large enterprise technology partners support and services ecosystems.
What we offer:
-Excellent medical, dental, and vision insurance
-Flexible time off + paid holidays.
-Equity + 401(k) plan

title: Video Editor -Marathi (Marketing )
jobDescription:
About Lokal

In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier-2/3 towns weren t really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they d come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online.This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in one place & one app - local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight - when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies & marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising.

Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission to connect Tier-2/3+ India to the Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts they ve always deserved.

We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like:

  • Edutainment & Skill Learning - practical skills and learning in regional languages (GyanTV)
  • Matrimonial Matchmaking - hyperlocal, compatibility-first partner search (Lokal Matrimony)
  • Agri Consulting - farmer-first advisory in local languages (AgriLokal)
  • Local Jobs - blue- and grey-collar opportunities close to home (Lokal Jobs, Sahi Jobs)
  • Social & Community - Place to find & post social updates (Lokal app)
  • Emotional Well-being & Peer Support - safe spaces to talk and feel heard (Dostt & Eaze)
  • Astrology & Guidance - instant access to trusted Astrologers via chat and voice (AstroLokal)
  • Advisory Services - early bets in legal help, financial guidance, career counselling, and more

Under the hood, Lokal is a discovery and access platform: local-language internet + deep Bharat insight+ AI. When someone opens a product we ve built, they don t wade through clutter; they get a straight line to what they came for.

This is the story new teammates walk into:
a company that started as a whatsapp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the centre - access changes lives.We ship fast.

We learn fast. We build for Bharat.We are backed by leading global and domestic investors including Y Combinator, Sony, Global Brain, India Quotient, and 3one4 Capital


About the Role

We are looking for a highly creative and skilled Video Editor to join our content team. You will be responsible for crafting compelling short-form and mid-length video content across platforms - from social media reels to promotional videos and branded content. This role requires a deep understanding of storytelling, editing trends, platform dynamics, and cultural nuances to create content that drives engagement and delivers impact.

Key Responsibilities

  • Edit short-form and mid-length videos such as reels, social media ads, promos, and content explainers.
  • Implement engaging hooks, dynamic pacing, and a strong narrative rhythm to maximize viewer retention.
  • Tailor editing styles to suit platform-specific behaviors (e.g., fast cuts for Instagram, scroll-stopping openers for YouTube Shorts).
  • Enhance video quality through thoughtful color grading, text animations, transitions, and immersive sound design.
  • Collaborate closely with writers, designers, and creative leads to bring scripts and visual concepts to life.
  • Stay updated on current editing trends, meme formats, cultural references, and audio trends to keep content fresh and relatable.
  • Analyze ad performance metrics and apply learnings to improve edits for better click-through and completion rates.
  • Edit videos in the required language Marathi, ensuring linguistic accuracy, cultural relevance, and strong storytelling for the target audience.
  • 1-2 years of experience in video editing for social media or digital content.
  • Proficiency in editing software like Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Final Cut Pro, or similar.
  • Strong portfolio of short-form content (reels, ads, promos).
  • Good understanding of social platform algorithms and engagement tactics.
  • Strong storytelling instincts, visual creativity, and sound design skills.
  • Language proficiency in Marathi & English and Ability to edit in Marathi with cultural sensitivity and linguistic command.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment with tight deadlines.

Here at Frontier, we help companies grow full-time, cross-functional teams abroad. We hire the smartest people, and we place them into the best companies. In three years, we ve never lost a client.

If you like one of the Frontier roles, and you apply, and you re accepted, we ll screen you with a couple of internal interviews, and will work on getting you an interview for a full-time job within the month.

About Tallee

Tallee is an AI Visibility platform that helps modern brands track, optimize, and improve how they appear across next-generation AI platforms and LLMs (such as ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and Google Gemini). As search and consumer discovery shift from traditional engines to AI, Tallee equips companies with the diagnostic insights, strategic roadmaps, and content ecosystem needed to ensure their brand is accurately represented and recommended.

About the Role

As a Technical Account Manager & AI Visibility Strategist, you will own client relationships while serving as the primary technical and strategic lead on brand AI visibility. This is not a traditional, relationship-only account management role - your core value lies at the intersection of technical credibility, diagnostic problem-solving, and strategic execution.

We heavily prioritize self-starters, particularly former founders or early-stage startup employees, who thrive in high-ownership, fast-evolving environments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform deep audits of how client brands show up across major LLMs; diagnose exactly why a brand is or isnt being surfaced, mentioned, or accurately represented.
  • Analyze the brand s end-to-end digital footprint, including website content, product/ingredient data, YouTube, social channels, Reddit, and brand partnerships/sponsorships.
  • Translate technical audit insights into clear, actionable roadmaps (e.g., identifying gaps in editorial content, or ensuring major sponsorships/partnerships are structured properly on-site for LLM ingestion).
  • Establish foundational priorities and collaborate directly with founders, strategy teams, and clients to align on which content and brand initiatives should be produced.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • Prior experience as a founder, co-founder, or early-stage employee at a fast-growing startup is strongly preferred.
  • Deep curiosity and practical understanding of LLMs, AI search mechanics, digital marketing, and modern SEO/content ecosystems.
  • Strong client-facing communication skills with the ability to build trust through technical authority and analytical clarity.
  • Proven track record of diagnosing messy, unstructured digital data and turning it into structured strategy.

Job Title: Product Support Engineer Experience: 0 to 2 years

Join our Product Support Team at SecPod and be a vital connection between our products and customers. Face real-world technical challenges by offering excellent support for advanced patch management, vulnerability management, and compliance auditing software. Your expertise will shine in understanding diverse customer environments and solving complex issues. From helping prevent cyberattacks to assisting with log analysis and vulnerability checks, youll be instrumental in reducing cyber risks and closing the gap in Cyber Exposure. -0 - 2 years of experience in customer support, technical support, system administration, or related customer-facing roles, particularly for large enterprise clients.

-Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

About Lokal

In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier-2/3 towns weren t really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they d come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online.This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in one place & one app - local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight - when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies & marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising.

Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission:
to connect Tier-2/3+ India to the Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts they ve always deserved. We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like:

  • Edutainment & Skill Learning - practical skills and learning in regional languages ( GyanTV )
  • Matrimonial Matchmaking - hyperlocal, compatibility-first partner search ( Lokal Matrimony )
  • Agri Consulting - farmer-first advisory in local languages ( AgriLokal )
  • Lokal Jobs - blue- and grey-collar opportunities close to home ( Lokal Jobs )
  • Social & Community - Place to find & post social updates ( Lokal app )
  • Emotional Well-being & Peer Support - safe spaces to talk and feel heard ( Dostt & Eaze )
  • Astrology & Guidance - instant access to trusted Astrologers via chat and voice ( AstroLokal )
  • Advisory Services - early bets in legal help, financial guidance, career counselling, and more

Under the hood, Lokal is a discovery and access platform: local-language internet + deep Bharat insight+ AI. When someone opens a product we ve built, they don t wade through clutter; they get a straight line to what they came for. This is the story new teammates walk into: a company that started as a whatsapp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the centere - access changes lives.

We ship fast. We learn fast. We build for Bharat.

We are backed by leading global and domestic investors including Y Combinator, Sony, Global Brain, India Quotient, and 3one4 Capital

descriptionFromApi:
About Lokal :

In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier-2/3 towns weren t really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they d come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online.

This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in one place & one app - local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight - when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies & marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising.

Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission:
to connect Tier-2/3+ India to the Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts they ve always deserved.

We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like:

  • Edutainment & Skill Learning - practical skills and learning in regional languages ( GyanTV )
  • Matrimonial Matchmaking - hyperlocal, compatibility-first partner search ( Lokal Matrimony )
  • Agri Consulting - farmer-first advisory in local languages ( AgriLokal )
  • Local Jobs - blue- and grey-collar opportunities close to home ( Lokal Jobs )
  • Social & Community - Place to find & post social updates ( Lokal app )
  • Emotional Well-being & Peer Support - safe spaces to talk and feel heard ( Dostt & Eaze )
  • Astrology & Guidance - instant access to trusted Astrologers via chat and voice ( AstroLokal )
    Advisory Services - early bets in legal help, financial guidance, career counselling, and more

Under the hood, Lokal is a discovery and access platform: local-language internet + deep India insight+ AI. When someone opens a product we ve built, they don t wade through clutter; they get a straight line to what they came for.

This is the story new teammates walk into:
a company that started as a whatsapp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the centre - access changes lives.

We ship fast. We learn fast.
And were now carrying that same belief beyond India, beginning with our first international, locally-sourced market in the Philippines. We are backed by leading global and domestic investors including Y Combinator, Sony, Global Brain, India Quotient, and 3one4 Capital

About AstroLokal :

AstroLokal is an astrology platform by Lokal that connects users with verified astrologers through chat, voice, and live interactions in multiple Indian languages. The platform offers personalized guidance across areas such as Vedic Astrology, Tarot, Numerology, Palmistry, Vastu, Horoscope Analysis, and other spiritual consultation services. AstroLokals mission is to make trusted astrology services accessible, engaging, and localized for users while enabling astrologers to build a sustainable practice and grow their earnings on the platform.

Role Overview :

The Lead Management Associate is responsible for sourcing, managing, and nurturing leads for astrologer onboarding. This role requires a proactive approach in identifying potential candidates through social media, online portals, and inbound inquiries while ensuring a smooth onboarding process.

Key Responsibilities :

  • Hunt for leads through social media platforms, lead generation portals, and other relevant sources.
  • Manage and track inbound leads from various sources (social media, referrals, inbound inquiries, etc.).
  • Reach out to potential astrologers, explain the onboarding process, and assess their suitability.
  • Coordinate with the quality teams to schedule assessments and interviews.
  • Maintain accurate records of lead interactions and progress in the CRM system.
  • Ensure timely follow-ups to maximize lead conversion rates.
  • Bachelors degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field.
  • 1-3 years of experience in lead generation,Astrologers Onboarding and Retention, Supply Operations.
  • Strong social media research and networking skills to source high-quality leads.
  • Must be fluent in Malayalam & English (Read, Write & Speak).
  • Proficiency in CRM tools and data management.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail

Why Join Us

We re scaling fast with strong fundamentals, on a mission to empower millions through AI and access. At Lokal, you ll take ownership from day one, build for real impact, and help redefine the roadmap of how Bharat connects to opportunities, knowledge, and experts.

Role Overview
This is a builders role. As a Product Success Analyst, you will sit directly with the clients problem, understand their business context, and build custom AI-driven solutions to solve it, using large language models (LLMs) and modern AI tooling. The model is forward-deployed: you work at the customers problem rather than behind the product. You will move fluidly between two modes, understanding the business (what the client actually needs, what will create value, what is feasible) and building the solution (configuring, prototyping and assembling AI-powered workflows that deliver it). Both matter equally: a solution nobody needs is as useless as a need nobody can build for. You will own engagements end-to-end across multiple modules and clients simultaneously, and work closely with our product and engineering teams to take what you build from prototype to production.

Key Responsibilities
- Understand the clients business problem: engage directly with customer stakeholders to uncover what they need, what is feasible, and where AI can create real value.
- Build custom solutions using AI and LLMs: design, prototype and assemble AI-powered workflows tailored to each client, using LLM tools, prompting, and light scripting to turn a business problem into a working solution.
- Own delivery end-to-end: drive engagements across FAis modules from pilot through full-scale rollout, across different client types and geographies.
- Work hands-on with data: prepare, structure and validate client datasets so that solutions are accurate and deployment-ready.
- Partner with product and engineering teams: take prototypes to production, feed client and field learnings back into the product, and help shape the roadmap.
- Manage client relationships: act as the day-to-day point of contact, manage expectations, and maintain engagement momentum and quality.
- Support pre-sales and solutioning: build quick proofs of concept and pre-analysis to demonstrate what FAi can do for prospective clients. Requirements
- 1-4 years of experience in a solutions, delivery, deployment, consulting, analytics, or product role.
- Demonstrated ability to build solutions using AI / LLMs - you have used tools like ChatGPT, Claude or similar, along with prompting and light scripting (e.g. Python), to build something that solved a real problem. This is the core of the role.
- Strong business and problem understanding: the ability to sit with an ambiguous, loosely-defined client problem, work out what actually needs solving, and translate it into a solution.
- Working proficiency with data: comfortable with Excel/Google Sheets and SQL, and structuring and validating data for use in a solution.
- Customer or stakeholder ownership: experience engaging external stakeholders directly, through delivery, implementation, or client-facing work.
- Strong written and verbal communication, able to engage both clients and internal technical teams clearly.
- Ability to manage multiple engagements concurrently across different clients and modules, including occasional field visits.

Good to Have
- Hands-on experience building with LLM APIs, agents, or AI automation / workflow tools.
- Exposure to FMCG, retail, CPG, or field-force / go-to-market domains.
- Conceptual familiarity with AI/ML, computer vision, or coverage optimisation (understanding of concepts, not model development from scratch).
- Experience in a startup or high-growth environment with fluid, evolving responsibilities.
- A bachelors degree in engineering, business, analytics, or a related field.

jobDescription:
Job Requirements
Collaboration Managed Services Engineer (L4)
Job Summary
The Collaboration Managed Services Engineer(L4) is responsible for ensuring a managed service is provided to all clients, ensuring that their voice, collaboration and or contact centre infrastructure and systems remain operational.
This is done through proactively managing, overseeing, monitoring, investigating, and resolving escalated technical incidents and problems to ensure the restoration of these services to the clients.

This role focuses on senior support for escalated incidents and requests with a high level of complexity. This role ensures contracted Managed Services outcomes are delivered to the client.

  • Proactively monitors the work queues and provides support to clients where the ticket is highly technical or sophisticated in nature
  • Works independently, with general direction from the client, stakeholders, team lead, or senior manager, to perform operational tasks to resolve all escalated incidents/requests in a timely manner within the agreed SLA Provides timely and consistent updates of tickets with resolution tasks performed
  • Proactively identifies, investigates, analyses issues and errors prior to or when they occur and log all such incidents in a timely manner
  • Captures all required and relevant information for immediate resolution
  • Provides forth level support to all escalated incidents, requests and identifies the root cause of incidents and problems, responds to tickets where third line engineer teams were unable to fix the problem
  • Shares such knowledge, to resolve issues, documents them, and pushes the knowledge down to other engineers
  • Communicates with other teams and clients for extending support
  • Acts as emergency support contact as needed, for critical client and business-impacting issues
  • Ensures that the shift handover process highlight any key escalated open tickets to be focussed on along with a handover of upcoming operation critical tasks to be carried out in the next shift
  • Supports, tracks, and documents change implementation
  • Provides timely escalation of all tickets to management with ensuing updates, where applicable
  • Proactively identifies, contributes, implements and works with automation teams for effort optimization and automating routine tasks
  • Systematically gathers relevant information and applies technical knowledge to analyse and uses highly technical troubleshooting tools and content and analytical practices
  • Uses operational and diagnostic procedures to resolve escalated tickers in unique and complex client environments
  • Coaches Service Desk, Operations Center, and L3 teams offering technical expertise and pushing work down to other engineering teams
  • Performs quality audits, covering process, service experience, ticket updates, etc as required
Knowledge, Skills and Attributes
Excellent proficiency in change management process with an ability to plan, monitor and execute changes with clear identification of risks and mitigation plans to be captured into the change record
Deep technical skills in relevant functions
Excellent client service orientation and passion for achieving or exceeding expectations
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Ability to communicate and work across different cultures and social groups
Ability to plan activities and projects well in advance, and takes into account possible changing circumstances
Ability to maintain a positive outlook at work
Ability to work well in a pressurized environment
Ability to work hard and put in longer hours when it is necessary
Ability to apply active listening techniques such as paraphrasing the message to confirm understanding, probing for further relevant information, and refraining from interrupting
Ability to adapt to changing circumstances
Ability to place clients at the forefront of all interactions, understanding their requirements, and create a positive client experience throughout the total client journey
Academic Qualifications and Certifications
Advanced degree or relevant qualification in IT/Computing (or demonstrated equivalent work experience)
IP, VoIP, Session Border Controllers (SBCs), Carrier technology experience and certifications.
CCIE Certification or equivalent
M365 Expert Certs
Preference is a Masters in Computer Science or equivalent
Certifications relevant to the services provided (certifications carry additional weightage on a candidates qualification for the role)
Required Experience
Advanced Managed Services experience
Strong knowledge of SIP, VoIP and Session Border Controllers (SBCs)
Experience of working with PSTN Telco Carriers.
Advanced knowledge and experience in ticketing tools, preferably Service Now
Worked in multiple large Global Enterprise client outsourcing projects
Track record of effective shift left work management skills (moving work to junior levels)
Advanced experience and understanding of the IT industry and standards for IT service management
Advanced experience across Emerging technology and trends impacting IT operations including Ai Technologies.
Skills (core 6 to 8)
Excellent understanding of complex voice, video and other collab modalities & environments, including a detailed understanding of the devices that run them.
Excellent understanding and troubleshooting skills of networking & routing protocols including SIP, VOIP, Operator Connect. Excellent understanding of a range of vendor SBCs, Media Gateways, Call Recording and eSIM technologies.
Able to gather, interpret and present call quality metrics in a meaningful way.
Excellent understanding of Contact Centre and Collaboration tools such as Cisco WebEx, Microsoft Teams, Genesys Pure Cloud & how to troubleshoot them.
Excellent understanding of call flows, auto attendants and call queues.
Excellent management of third party carriers and partners to ensure ticket progress and resolution in a timely fashion. An appreciation and ability to troubleshoot issues with global number porting processes.

Position Overview
The Test Engineer will own hands-on quality engineering for the AWS Policy Master flow, with primary emphasis on automated data, API, integration, reconciliation, resilience, performance, and production-readiness testing. The role validates that policy feeds are accurately processed from S3 through Lambda and SQS into Aurora and are securely exposed through APIs. The engineer will collaborate closely with developers and business SMEs to build traceable test coverage, detect defects early, validate nonfunctional requirements, and provide objective release-readiness evidence.
Required Skills and Experience
  • 57 years of software testing or quality-engineering experience, including substantial automation experience on cloud, data, API, integration, or distributed-system programs.
  • Hands-on experience testing AWS-based solutions using services such as S3, Lambda, SQS, EventBridge, Aurora PostgreSQL, API Gateway, CloudWatch, IAM, and KMS.
  • Strong skills in SQL and data validation, including source-to-target reconciliation, transformation-rule testing, referential integrity, duplicates, nulls, control totals, historical or effective-dated data, and exception validation.
  • Experience building automated test frameworks using Python, Java, or JavaScript and tools such as pytest, JUnit, REST Assured, Postman/Newman, Karate, or equivalent.
  • Experience with REST API testing covering contracts, schemas, authentication and authorization, pagination, versioning, throttling, negative scenarios, error responses, and performance.
  • Practical experience testing asynchronous and event-driven patterns, including message sequencing, duplicate delivery, idempotency, retry, dead-letter queues, replay, partial failure, and eventual consistency.
  • Experience with performance and reliability tools such as JMeter, Gatling, k6, or equivalent, plus observability through CloudWatch logs, metrics, dashboards, and alerts.
  • Working knowledge of CI/CD quality gates, Git workflows, defect management, test-data management, environment readiness, and traceability from requirements to test evidence.
  • Strong analytical and communication skills, with the ability to isolate defects across application, data, infrastructure, and integration layers and communicate business impact clearly.
  • Insurance policy-domain knowledge, testing of policy administration or ODS solutions, and familiarity with PII or regulated-data controls are preferred; ISTQB or an AWS certification is an advantage.
Duties
  • Translate business, data, API, security, and nonfunctional requirements into a risk-based test strategy, detailed scenarios, automation scope, and entry or exit criteria.
  • Develop and execute automated tests across S3 landing, Lambda validation, SQS buffering, transformation processing, Aurora persistence, and API consumption.
  • Validate source-to-target mappings and canonical policy rules through record-level comparison, aggregate reconciliation, control totals, exception reporting, and negative-data scenarios.
  • Test asynchronous behavior including duplicate messages, out-of-order events, poison messages, retries, dead-letter queues, replay, timeout, partial failure, and recovery without data loss or corruption.
  • Automate API functional, contract, authorization, error-handling, throttling, versioning, and regression tests and integrate them into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Execute performance, load, volume, endurance, concurrency, and resilience testing against agreed service levels; identify bottlenecks across Lambda, queues, Aurora, and APIs.
  • Validate security controls including least-privilege access, encryption, secrets handling, sensitive-data masking, audit events, and unauthorized-access behavior in partnership with security teams.
  • Create representative and privacy-compliant test data, manage test-data refreshes, and maintain reusable automated datasets and expected-results libraries.
  • Log high-quality defects with evidence, severity, reproducibility, impacted data or services, and likely failure layer; support triage, root-cause isolation, retesting, and closure.
  • Track coverage, automation rate, pass or fail trends, defect leakage, reconciliation results, performance findings, and residual risk; provide an evidence-based release recommendation.

jobDescription:
About Zenara

Zenara is building technology to enable a new way to practise psychiatry: whole-person, continuous and psychiatrist-led care.

Our products help psychiatric practices understand patients more deeply before visits, capture more useful signal between visits, and support more consistent ongoing care - while keeping the psychiatrist firmly at the centre of clinical decision-making.

We are a growing, distributed company with team members working across India and other international markets. We are expanding the team, and we need a highly organised and trusted person to strengthen our recruitment, people-operations and executive-administration capabilities.

About the role

You will support our founders and leadership team across four connected areas: recruitment coordination, HR and people administration, timesheet and payroll administration, and confidential executive support.

This is a hands-on, execution-focused role. You will keep processes moving, maintain accurate records, communicate clearly with candidates and colleagues, and make sure agreed tasks are completed reliably and on time.

To be clear about the level: this is not a senior HR strategy or employment-law role. We are looking for someone practical, highly organised, discreet, and capable of independently running routine people and administrative workflows without being chased.

You will have access to sensitive information - employee records, compensation details, candidate information, company plans and leadership discussions. Trust, discretion and sound judgement are essential parts of the job, not add-ons to it.

What you will own 1. Recruitment coordination
  • Maintain the recruitment pipeline across multiple open positions
  • Keep Workable, Linear and other recruitment trackers accurate and up to date
  • Review incoming applications against agreed role requirements
  • Organise and prioritise candidates for review
  • Coordinate first-round screening and interviews
  • Communicate with candidates throughout the process
  • Schedule interviews across India, US and other relevant time zones
  • Send interview instructions, reminders and follow-ups
  • Track candidate completion of screening, interviews and assessments
  • Coordinate background and reference checks where required
  • Prepare candidate information for interviewers
  • Maintain accurate records of interview outcomes and next steps
  • Make sure candidates are followed up promptly and professionally
  • Support offer, pre-boarding and onboarding administration
  • Help improve our recruitment workflows and systems as we scale

We are building technology-supported recruitment workflows, including automated candidate screening, interview processes, ranking and follow-up. You will help operate, monitor and improve those workflows rather than relying only on manual administration.

2. HR and people administration
  • Maintain accurate employee records and HR documentation
  • Support employee onboarding and offboarding
  • Coordinate collection of required employee information and documents
  • Track leave, attendance and other routine people-administration matters
  • Maintain records of probation periods, review dates and employment milestones
  • Prepare standard HR letters, documents and internal records
  • Support the administration of employment agreements
  • Make sure routine HR processes are completed consistently and on time
  • Respond to straightforward employee administration questions
  • Escalate sensitive or complex employee matters to the founders
  • Keep HR files organised, accurate and accessible

This role provides HR administration and coordination. You will not be expected to provide independent legal, employment-law or senior employee-relations advice.

3. Timesheets and payroll administration
  • Collect and monitor employee timesheets
  • Follow up on missing or incomplete submissions
  • Maintain accurate records for payroll processing
  • Prepare payroll inputs for review and submission
  • Coordinate with payroll providers, accountants and other relevant parties
  • Track payroll-related questions and issues
  • Maintain records of approved payments and payroll documentation

You will not own payroll, compensation or employment-policy decisions. Your responsibility is to make sure the administrative process is accurate, organised and completed on time.

4. Executive assistance
  • Provide trusted administrative support to our two co-founders
  • Manage and coordinate calendars and meetings
  • Schedule internal and external meetings
  • Prepare agendas, action lists and follow-up trackers
  • Record or organise meeting actions where required
  • Follow up with team members on agreed actions
  • Coordinate travel arrangements and related logistics
  • Organise documents and information for leadership discussions
  • Assist with practical administrative tasks and research
  • Support occasional projects that need careful coordination and follow-through

This will include practical, get-it-done administrative work. You should be comfortable handling a broad range of tasks without losing sight of priorities.

5. Confidentiality and information management
  • Treat employee, candidate, compensation and company information as strictly confidential
  • Store and share sensitive information only through approved systems
  • Use sound judgement about who should have access to what
  • Maintain professional boundaries with colleagues
  • Avoid informal discussion of confidential matters
  • Escalate any suspected confidentiality or data-security issue immediately

About the Project

TSMG is looking for Quality control specialists to support an AI language project focused on improving speech recognition systems.

As a QC contributor, you will review completed language annotation tasks and ensure that AI-generated transcripts have been accurately converted into natural, readable display text according to the project guidelines.     • capitalization;
    • numbers, dates, times, and currencies;

  • Ensure that the original words and meaning have been preserved.
  • Identify and correct formatting or guideline-related errors.

  • Excellent written skills in the target language.
